faq_heading: GlenBrooke North condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in GlenBrooke North. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

GlenBrooke North, New Westminster: 10 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 20%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 7 of 14 New Westminster communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the New Westminster total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in GlenBrooke North was little changed, 10 in June and 10 in September (+0.0%), and 8 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 2.3% of New Westminster’s 444 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in GlenBrooke North?

blocks.text: GlenBrooke North home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

12 condos sold in GlenBrooke North with a median price of $540,000 (the middle half sold between $507,250 and $602,000), taking a median of 36 days to sell at 96.3% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $667 per square foot, a median year built of 2006 and a median strata fee of $458 a month. 5 townhomes sold in GlenBrooke North with a median price of $710,000, taking a median of 85 days to sell at 97.5% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $689 per square foot, a median year built of 2002 and a median strata fee of $567 a month.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in GlenBrooke North?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 10 condos and townhomes listed in GlenBrooke North. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is GlenBrooke North a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in GlenBrooke North had a sales ratio of 20%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in GlenBrooke North from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 8 condos and townhomes sold in GlenBrooke North over those 4 months, out of 261 in all of New Westminster.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did condos in GlenBrooke North sell for?
faq.a: 12 condos sold in GlenBrooke North between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $540,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in GlenBrooke North?
faq.a: The median was 36 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.3% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
